item.title: Gift Your Home Warmth and Savings (Shop Now!)

You can remotely control your home’s heating with your mobile device. Hosting dinner at your house this year? Your smart thermostat automatically adjusts to a hot kitchen and a lot of extra people, keeping everyone comfortable.

In fact, ENERGY STAR® certified smart thermostats can help you save as much as $100 every year in heating and cooling costs.* Even better? Division of Power customers can get a top-rated smart thermostat for as low as $9.99** at the City of Columbus Smart Thermostat Marketplace.

item.title: ⚡It’s the Perfect Month to Save Energy and Money (Details Inside!)
item.description:
It’s Energy Awareness Month — How Much Can You Save?

With cold nights and warm days, October can mean constantly running back and forth to the thermostat. Sensi™ smart thermostats can help you save steps — and save about 23%* on HVAC energy. These ENERGY STAR® certified smart devices keep you comfortable while also looking for ways to save energy. Plus, they can be adjusted from anywhere using your mobile device.

And now, just in time for Energy Awareness Month, they’re available on the City of Columbus Smart Thermostat Marketplace with special pricing exclusively for Division of Power customers!*

Shop Now

*Energy savings are calculated by comparing operation time for a nationwide sample of Sensi users with temperature adjustments averaging 4° in comparison to users with no adjustments. Savings vary based on equipment type/condition, insulation, climate and temperature adjustment size/frequency. Learn more at https://sensi.copeland.com/en-us/savings.
